comment: C-first independent v12 case for lock.c:pick_lock and the locked-container use path: wish a locked chest and skeleton key, drop the chest, apply the key to the chest underfoot, and confirm the unlock. C emits "You succeed in unlocking the chest. You trigger a trap!" with picklock RNG; unlike the v8 tipped trapped-box probe, this tests key-based unlocking and traps only after the chest opens.
name: skeleton-key-unlocks-trapped-chest
description: Unlock a wished locked chest with an independently wished skeleton key, then reach the C trap response.
